newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Finemore says sees acquisition chances.
newsitem.headline: Finemore says sees acquisition chances.

text.p: Transport group Finemore Holdings Ltd said on Monday it expected the ongoing rationalisation of the transport industry to present the company with many acquisition possibilities.
"We are hopeful that some of these will fit our future plans and direction, whilst being priced realistically," managing director Ronald Finemore said in a statement accompanying its annual results.
"It is my belief that in a low inflationary environment, the last thing we should do is pay too much for any business," he added.
